title: Redis
description: In-memory key/value store, used as a cache, a session store and a queue.

fields.name: port
fields.label: Host port
fields.help: The port Redis is published on. Leave it closed to the internet: Redis has no user accounts.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Redis only has this one credential. Anything that reaches the port and knows it has full access.

fields.name: data_volume
fields.label: Data volume
fields.help: Where the append-only file lives. Empty names one after the container.

notes: Redis is listening on port {{port}} with the password you set. It has no user accounts and no TLS — keep the port on a private network or behind a proxy.
